summary: Plains All American Pipeline, L.P. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of fixed-to-fixed reset rate junior subordinated notes due 2056, split into Series A resetting in 2031 and Series B resetting in 2036. The notes are unsecured, junior to senior indebtedness, unguaranteed by subsidiaries, and include a 20-period interest-deferral option. Interest is semi-annual each June 15 and December 15, beginning June 15, 2027. No board recommendation, advisor, or pricing terms are stated in the excerpt; this is a routine debt capital markets shelf takedown, not a special situation.
